en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large European square bustling with people, trams, and a military parade of uniformed soldiers marching with rifles. In the center stands an equestrian monument on a high pedestal. Around the square are grand multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs and clock towers, tree‑lined streets, ornate lampposts, and a kiosk covered with period advertisements in German. The clothing and vehicles suggest an early‑20th‑century setting.
